name: King Slime
summon: Use it in any biome, at any time. King Slime also spawns on its own during a Slime Rain.

drops.name: Crown Jewel
drops.effect: Grants +0.5 HP/s life regen and reduces damage-over-time taken by 2 HP/s.

drops.name: Katana
drops.effect: A fast, autoswinging katana.

drops.name: Slimy Saddle
drops.effect: Summons the Slime Mount, which hovers and slams down onto enemies.

drops.name: Slime Gun
drops.effect: Sprays harmless slime - a novelty item that deals no damage.

drops.name: Slime Hook
drops.effect: A single-claw grappling hook with slime-green reach.

drops.name: Ninja Hood
drops.effect: Vanity headpiece from the ninja trapped inside King Slime.

drops.name: Ninja Shirt
drops.effect: Vanity shirt from the ninja trapped inside King Slime.

drops.name: Ninja Pants
drops.effect: Vanity leggings from the ninja trapped inside King Slime.

drops.name: King Slime Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like King Slime's crown and face.

drops.name: Royal Gel
drops.effect: Slimes become friendly and no longer harm you.

blurb: A giant slime with a ninja trapped inside. It teleports, spawns smaller slimes, and shrinks as it loses health.

summonItem.name: Slime Crown
summonItem.effect: Summons King Slime when used, in any biome at any time.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: Desert Scourge
summon: Use it in the Desert or Underground Desert.

drops.name: Sahara Slicers
drops.effect: When swung, a pair of dual daggers rapidly stab in front of the player. Hitting an enemy with one of the daggers will spawn 2 bolts which appear behind the player, up to a maximum of 10.

drops.name: Barinade
drops.effect: Fires two converging high-velocity fin arrows that soar through the air.

drops.name: Sandstream Scepter
drops.effect: Fires an explosive stream of sand that detonates when the projectile expires.

drops.name: Brittle Star Staff
drops.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

drops.name: Scourge of the Desert
drops.effect: When used, it throws a javelin that burrows into tiles and launches itself towards the closest enemy when burrowing through tiles. Thrown javelins are slightly affected by gravity and pierce twice.

drops.name: Sand Cloak
drops.effect: Dashing creates a protective sand veil that damages enemies and grants +3 defense and 75% acceleration inside it.

drops.name: Ocean Crest
drops.effect: Recover air while standing still underwater, and 15% increased mining speed while wet.

drops.name: Desert Scourge Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask modeled on the Desert Scourge.

blurb: A worm boss fought in the Desert. It burrows through blocks and rams the player, moving in segments like a regular worm enemy.

summonItem.name: Desert Medallion
summonItem.effect: Summons the Desert Scourge when used in the Desert; enrages elsewhere. Reusable.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

unlocks: Sandstorms can now occur naturally, and the Sunken Sea opens up - fish there for the Sparkling Empress and Sea Spirit Amulet, and Giant Clams start to spawn. Prism-Backs begin dropping Prism Shards, and Ghost Bells drop Voltaic Jelly.

name: Eye of Cthulhu
summon: Use it at night to summon the Eye. It can also spawn on its own at night once you have 200 HP and a few defeated town NPCs.

drops.name: Teardrop Cleaver
drops.effect: A broadsword that inflicts Temporal Sadness on hit, sharply slowing enemy movement.

drops.name: Deathstare Rod
drops.effect: Summons a floating eye above your head that watches you and shoots at enemies. Only one can exist at a time.

drops.name: Demonite Ore
drops.effect: The Corruption world's first upgrade ore; smelt it into Demonite Bars.

drops.name: Corrupt Seeds
drops.effect: Plants a patch of Corruption where used.

drops.name: Crimtane Ore
drops.effect: The Crimson world's first upgrade ore; smelt it into Crimtane Bars.

drops.name: Crimson Seeds
drops.effect: Plants a patch of Crimson where used.

drops.name: Eye of Cthulhu Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like the Eye of Cthulhu.

drops.name: Shield of Cthulhu
drops.effect: Dash into enemies to damage and knock them back; also cancels fall damage.

blurb: Summoned at night with a Suspicious Looking Eye. It circles and spawns Servants until half health, then stops summoning and charges instead.
unlocks: Can now smelt Demonite/Crimtane Bars for the first evil-metal weapons (Light’s Bane, the Demon Bow, and more).

summonItem.name: Suspicious Looking Eye
summonItem.effect: Summons the Eye of Cthulhu when used at night.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: Crabulon
summon: Use the Decapodita Sprout in the Glowing Mushroom biome at any time.

drops.name: Mycelial Claws
drops.effect: A fast autoswinging claw that grants the Mushy buff on hit, boosting life regen.

drops.name: Fungicide
drops.effect: Converts musket balls into fungal rounds that split into spores on impact.

drops.name: Hyphae Rod
drops.effect: Fires a bouncing spore that creates lingering mushroom clouds near the player.

drops.name: Infested Clawmerang
drops.effect: A slow, long-ranged rogue boomerang. Stealth strikes summon homing spores and grant the Mushy buff.

drops.name: Mycoroot
drops.effect: Fires a stream of short-range fungal roots. Stealth strikes burst into an explosion of spores.

drops.name: Puff Shroom
drops.effect: Summons a mushroom warrior minion that fights for you and grants the Puff Warrior buff.

drops.name: Mushroom Plasma Root
drops.effect: Permanent power-up. Increases the duration of Rage Mode by 1 second when consumed.

drops.name: Crabulon Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like Crabulon's fungal crab head.

blurb: Fought in the Glowing Mushroom biome. It walks and jumps at the player while firing mushroom projectiles and summoning Crab Shroom minions.

summonItem.name: Decapodita Sprout
summonItem.effect: Summons Crabulon when used inside the Glowing Mushroom biome.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: Eater of Worlds
summon: Use it in the Corruption or Underground Corruption. It is also summoned by smashing three Shadow Orbs.

drops.name: Shadow Scale
drops.effect: Corruption crafting material for Shadow armor and demonite tools.

drops.name: Demonite Ore
drops.effect: Smelt it into Demonite Bars - the Eater drops it in bulk.

drops.name: Eater's Bone
drops.effect: Summons a miniature Eater of Worlds to follow you.

drops.name: Eater of Worlds Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like the Eater of Worlds' head.

drops.name: Worm Scarf
drops.effect: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.

blurb: A segmented worm, Corruption worlds only. Destroying a middle segment splits it into two shorter worms, so piercing weapons hit many segments at once.
unlocks: Can now craft Shadow armor and the Nightmare Pickaxe.

summonItem.name: Worm Food
summonItem.effect: Summons the Eater of Worlds when used in the Corruption.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: Brain of Cthulhu
summon: Use it in the Crimson. It is also summoned by smashing three Crimson Hearts.

drops.name: Tissue Sample
drops.effect: Crimson crafting material for Crimson armor and crimtane tools - dropped by the Creepers that swarm the Brain.

drops.name: Crimtane Ore
drops.effect: Smelt it into Crimtane Bars - the Brain drops it in bulk.

drops.name: Brain of Cthulhu Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like the Brain of Cthulhu.

drops.name: Brain of Confusion
drops.effect: A chance to dodge attacks, and confuses nearby enemies when you are hit.

blurb: Crimson worlds only. It is invulnerable until its ring of Creepers is killed, then teleports and spawns illusions of itself.
unlocks: Can now craft Crimson armor and the Deathbringer Pickaxe.

summonItem.name: Bloody Spine
summonItem.effect: Summons the Brain of Cthulhu when used in the Crimson.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: The Hive Mind
summon: Kill a Hive Tumor in the Corruption to summon it. After the first kill you can craft a Teratoma to summon it in the Corruption at any time.

drops.name: Perfect Dark
drops.effect: A broadsword that fires a vile ball which sticks to tiles and explodes.

drops.name: Shadethrower
drops.effect: Spits clouds of shade that afflict enemies with Shadowflame.

drops.name: Shaderain Staff
drops.effect: Fires a spray of evil clouds and rain onto enemies.

drops.name: Dank Staff
drops.effect: Summons a dank creeper minion to fight for you.

drops.name: Rot Ball
drops.effect: A thrown rogue ball. Stealth strikes spawn rain clouds on enemy hits.

drops.name: Filthy Glove
drops.effect: Stealth strikes gain +8 armor penetration and deal 8% more damage.

drops.name: Rotting Eyeball
drops.effect: Summons a corrupted conglomeration pet to follow you.

drops.name: Hive Mind Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like The Hive Mind.

blurb: A Corruption boss. It stays stationary and summons enemies in Phase 1, then drifts toward the player and attacks directly in Phase 2. Enrages outside the Corruption.

summonItem.name: Teratoma
summonItem.effect: Summons The Hive Mind when used in the Corruption.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: The Perforators
summon: Kill a Perforator Cyst in the Crimson to summon them. After the first kill you can craft a Bloody Worm Food to summon them in the Crimson at any time.

drops.name: Aorta
drops.effect: A yoyo that fires homing blood when enemies are near.

drops.name: Sausage Maker
drops.effect: A spear that sprays homing blood on hit.

drops.name: Vein Burster
drops.effect: A broadsword that fires a blood ball which sticks to tiles and explodes.

drops.name: Eviscerator
drops.effect: Converts musket balls into fast-moving blood clots.

drops.name: Blood Bath
drops.effect: Drenches your foes in blood, dealing rapid magic damage.

drops.name: Flesh of Infidelity
drops.effect: Summons a tentacled ball of flesh that splashes blood onto enemies.

drops.name: Tooth Ball
drops.effect: A thrown rogue ball. Stealth strikes spawn rain clouds on enemy hits.

drops.name: Bloodstained Glove
drops.effect: Stealth strikes gain +8 armor penetration and heal 5 HP.

drops.name: Bloody Vein
drops.effect: Summons an amalgamated pile of flesh pet to follow you.

drops.name: Perforator Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like The Perforators.

blurb: A Crimson boss. The Perforator Hive hovers above the player and drops projectiles, spawning small, medium, and large Perforator worms as it loses health.

summonItem.name: Bloody Worm Food
summonItem.effect: Summons The Perforators when used in the Crimson.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: Queen Bee
summon: Use it anywhere in the Jungle. She also spawns if you break a Larva inside a Bee Hive.

drops.name: Bee Keeper
drops.effect: A broadsword that releases bees on every hit.

drops.name: Bee Gun
drops.effect: Fires a swarm of homing bees.

drops.name: The Bee's Knees
drops.effect: Turns wooden arrows into homing bees.

drops.name: Hardened Honeycomb
drops.effect: Fires a honeycomb that shatters into fragments. Stealth strikes grant a bee-summoning buff.

drops.name: Hive Wand
drops.effect: Places Hive blocks.

drops.name: Honey Comb
drops.effect: Releases a swarm of bees when you take damage.

drops.name: The Bee
drops.effect: At full HP your damage scales with your damage reduction, and damage taken at full HP is halved.

drops.name: Nectar
drops.effect: Summons a Baby Hornet to follow you.

drops.name: Honeyed Goggles
drops.effect: Summons the Bee Mount, which grants limited flight.

drops.name: Beenade
drops.effect: A thrown grenade that bursts into bees on impact.

drops.name: Bee Wax
drops.effect: Crafting material for Bee armor and bee-themed gear.

drops.name: Queen Bee Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like the Queen Bee.

drops.name: Hive Pack
drops.effect: Bees and wasps from your weapons become larger and more damaging.

blurb: Fought in the Jungle. She alternates between charging horizontally, firing stingers, and spawning bees, so a long flat arena works best.
unlocks: The Witch Doctor NPC can now move in - he sells summoner gear and the Imbuing Station.

summonItem.name: Abeemination
summonItem.effect: Summons the Queen Bee when used in a Jungle biome.

name: Skeletron
summon: Talk to the Old Man at the Dungeon entrance at night and choose 'Curse'. Beat him before dawn or he despawns.

drops.name: Book of Skulls
drops.effect: Fires a skull that pierces through enemies.

drops.name: Skeletron Hand
drops.effect: A grappling hook made from Skeletron's severed hand.

drops.name: Skeletron Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like Skeletron's skull.

drops.name: Bone Glove
drops.effect: Throws a damaging bone whenever you use a weapon.

blurb: Guards the Dungeon entrance and is summoned by speaking to the Old Man at night. He kills instantly at dawn.
unlocks: Opens the Dungeon (its Guardian stops killing you at the entrance), and the Old Man becomes the Clothier NPC.

name: Deerclops
summon: Use it in a Snow biome at night. Deerclops can also spawn on its own during a Blizzard.

drops.name: Pew-matic Horn
drops.effect: Fires random projectiles - bullets, coins, darts, and more.

drops.name: Weather Pain
drops.effect: A hammer that launches a controllable cloud dealing area damage.

drops.name: Houndius Shootius
drops.effect: Summons a Houndius Shootius sentry that fires eye lasers at nearby enemies.

drops.name: Lucy the Axe
drops.effect: A talking axe that can be swung or thrown and returns to you.

drops.name: Eye Bone
drops.effect: Summons Chester, a mobile storage chest that follows you.

drops.name: Eyebrella
drops.effect: A vanity umbrella-eye hat from the Don’t Starve crossover.

drops.name: Deerclops Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like Deerclops.

blurb: A Don't Starve crossover fought in the Snow biome. Ground-based, with a shadow attack that reaches through blocks.

summonItem.name: Deer Thing
summonItem.effect: Summons Deerclops when used in a Snow biome.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: The Slime God
summon: Use the Overloaded Sludge anywhere, at any time.

drops.name: Overloaded Blaster
drops.effect: Converts gel into a spread of energized slime pearls that overload when they stop.

drops.name: Abyssal Tome
drops.effect: Casts a slow-moving ball of dark energy.

drops.name: Eldritch Tome
drops.effect: Casts eldritch tentacles to spear your enemies.

drops.name: Corroslime Staff
drops.effect: Summons a corro slime minion to fight for you.

drops.name: Crimslime Staff
drops.effect: Summons a crim slime minion to fight for you.

drops.name: Purified Gel
drops.effect: Calamity crafting material used for early gear and ammo.

drops.name: Slime God Mask (Corruption)
drops.effect: A vanity mask of the Slime God - drops in Corruption worlds.

drops.name: Slime God Mask (Crimson)
drops.effect: A vanity mask of the Slime God - drops in Crimson worlds.

blurb: Made up of the Slime God Core and its two paladins. The core cannot be damaged, so the fight is won by defeating both paladins.

summonItem.name: Overloaded Sludge
summonItem.effect: Summons The Slime God when used.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: Wall of Flesh
summon: Throw a Guide Voodoo Doll into lava in the Underworld while the Guide is alive - it kills the Guide and spawns the Wall.

drops.name: Pwnhammer
drops.effect: Smashes Demon and Crimson Altars, seeding the world with Hardmode ores.

drops.name: Breaker Blade
drops.effect: A heavy, slow broadsword with very high base damage.

drops.name: Clockwork Assault Rifle
drops.effect: Fires a three-round burst with each shot.

drops.name: Meowthrower
drops.effect: A flamethrower that occasionally launches homing feline projectiles.

drops.name: Laser Rifle
drops.effect: Fires a rapid, mana-cheap laser beam.

drops.name: Black Hawk Remote
drops.effect: Summons a Black Hawk jet minion that fires bullets from your inventory.

drops.name: Firecracker
drops.effect: A whip that makes the next minion strike on the tagged enemy detonate for bonus damage.

drops.name: Blast Barrel
drops.effect: Throws a rolling barrel that explodes on wall collision. Stealth strikes make it bounce twice.

drops.name: Carnage
drops.effect: A broadsword that makes enemies explode into homing blood on death.

drops.name: Warrior Emblem
drops.effect: Increases melee damage by 15%.

drops.name: Ranger Emblem
drops.effect: Increases ranged damage by 15%.

drops.name: Sorcerer Emblem
drops.effect: Increases magic damage by 15%.

drops.name: Summoner Emblem
drops.effect: Increases summon damage by 15%.

drops.name: Rogue Emblem
drops.effect: Increases rogue damage by 15%.

drops.name: Wall of Flesh Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like the Wall of Flesh.

drops.name: Demon Heart
drops.effect: Permanently unlocks a sixth accessory slot.

blurb: Summoned by throwing a Guide Voodoo Doll into Underworld lava. It moves across the world at a steady speed, so the fight should happen on a long bridge, and it speeds up as it loses health.
unlocks: Activates Hardmode. With Calamity’s Early Hardmode Rework, Cobalt/Palladium Ore spawn immediately (no altar-smashing needed), the Hallow appears, mechanical bosses can spawn at night, and Life Fruit and Plantera’s Bulbs start growing in the Jungle.

summonItem.name: Guide Voodoo Doll
summonItem.effect: Thrown into lava in the Underworld (while the Guide is alive) to summon the Wall of Flesh.
summonItem.source: Dropped by Voodoo Demons in the Underworld

name: Queen Slime
summon: Place a Gelatin Crystal in the Hallow and activate it. The crystal generates naturally in the Underground Hallow.

drops.name: Crystal Assassin Hood
drops.effect: Crystal Assassin set - grants a dash and +10% damage and critical strike chance.

drops.name: Crystal Assassin Shirt
drops.effect: Part of the Crystal Assassin set - a dash and +10% damage and crit.

drops.name: Crystal Assassin Pants
drops.effect: Part of the Crystal Assassin set - a dash and +10% damage and crit.

drops.name: Blade Staff
drops.effect: Summons an Enchanted Dagger minion - low base damage that ramps hard with armor penetration.

drops.name: Gelatinous Pillion
drops.effect: Summons a slime mount that hovers and bounces high off enemies.

drops.name: Hook of Dissonance
drops.effect: A grappling hook that teleports you to wherever it latches.

drops.name: Queen Slime Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like Queen Slime.

drops.name: Volatile Gelatin
drops.effect: Occasionally launches a bouncing gel projectile at nearby enemies.

blurb: Summoned in the Hallow with a Gelatin Crystal. She gains flight in her later phases and spawns crystal slimes throughout.

summonItem.name: Gelatin Crystal
summonItem.effect: Placed in the Hallow and activated to summon Queen Slime.

name: Cryogen
summon: Use a Cryo Key in the Snow or Ice biome at any time.

drops.name: Avalanche
drops.effect: A broadsword whose hits spawn orbiting ice bombs that later explode.

drops.name: Hoarfrost Bow
drops.effect: Fires two arrows at once and converts wooden arrows into frost mist arrows.

drops.name: Snowstorm Staff
drops.effect: Fires cursor-tracking snowflakes that split into ice stars on hit.

drops.name: Icebreaker
drops.effect: Throws an icy hammer that returns to you. Stealth strikes spawn a cosmic explosion.

drops.name: Glacial Embrace
drops.effect: Summons the power of the ancient ice castle, adding an attack per minion slot used.

drops.name: Cryo Stone
drops.effect: Creates a rotating ice shield that damages and slows enemies, and boosts Cold debuff damage.

drops.name: Frost Flare
drops.effect: All attacks inflict Frostbite; above 50% life grants +10% damage, below 50% grants +10 defense.

drops.name: Essence of Eleum
drops.effect: Calamity ice crafting material used for early Hardmode gear.

drops.name: Cryogen Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like Cryogen.

blurb: An ice boss summoned in the Snow or Ice biome. It spawns behind an ice shield that must be broken, then shifts attack patterns through several phases as its health drops.

summonItem.name: Cryo Key
summonItem.effect: Summons Cryogen when used in the Snow or Ice biome.
summonItem.source: Crafted at an Iron or Lead Anvil

name: The Twins
summon: Use it at night in Hardmode. The Twins can also spawn on their own at night.

drops.name: Soul of Sight
drops.effect: Hardmode crafting material used for the Optic Staff, the Marrow, and more.

drops.name: Hallowed Bar
drops.effect: Crafts Hallowed armor, drills and chainsaws, and mech-tier weapons. Mechs only drop it once all three are defeated.

drops.name: Twin Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like The Twins.

blurb: Two mechanical eyes. Spazmatism deals contact damage and cursed flames, Retinazer fires lasers, and each changes form below half health.
unlocks: Advances the Hardmode ore tier by defeat order: the 1st mech beaten spawns Mythril and Orichalcum, the 2nd Adamantite and Titanium, and the 3rd Hallowed Ore in the Underground Hallow - after which all mechs drop Hallowed Bars.

summonItem.name: Mechanical Eye
summonItem.effect: Summons The Twins at night in Hardmode.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Mythril or Orichalcum Anvil

name: Aquatic Scourge
summon: Use a Seafood item at any time.
blurb: A mutated sea serpent of the Sulphurous Sea with acidic toxin attacks and murky teal coloration.

name: The Destroyer
summon: Use a Mechanical Worm at night.
blurb: A vanilla mechanical worm bristling with lasers and probes, one of the required Hardmode mechs.

name: Brimstone Elemental
summon: Use a Charred Idol in the Brimstone Crag.
blurb: A fiery red-and-orange elemental of the Brimstone Crag that escalates aggression across three attack phases.

name: Skeletron Prime
summon: Use a Mechanical Skull at night.
blurb: A vanilla mechanical skull with spinning limbs, the last of the three mechs before Plantera opens up.

name: Calamitas Clone
summon: Use an Eye of Desolation at night.
blurb: A brimstone-themed clone that chases the player while summoning minion constructs, gating post-mech Calamity gear.

name: Plantera
summon: Break a Plantera's Bulb in the Underground Jungle.
blurb: The vanilla jungle boss whose defeat unlocks the Jungle Temple and much of the late Hardmode roadmap.

name: Leviathan and Anahita
summon: Use a Naiad's Warhorn item in the Ocean biome.
blurb: An ocean-themed duo pairing a water elemental with a massive marine reptile that unleash ice and meteor attacks.

name: Astrum Aureus
summon: Use an Astral Chunk in the Astral Infection biome.
blurb: A mechanical construct corrupted by the Astral Infection, leaping and firing laser spreads with a golden cosmic sheen.

name: Golem
summon: Use a Lihzahrd Power Cell at the altar in the Jungle Temple.
blurb: The vanilla Lihzahrd Temple guardian whose defeat opens post-Golem progression.

name: Duke Fishron
summon: Fish with Truffle Worm bait in the Ocean biome.
blurb: An optional vanilla pigron-dragon of the Ocean, dangerous but dropping some of the best endgame-adjacent weapons.

name: The Plaguebringer Goliath
summon: Use an Abombination item in the Jungle or Underground Jungle.
blurb: A Draedon-built plague creature of biological control, sickly green and bristling with toxic missile and drone attacks.

name: Empress of Light
summon: Kill a Prismatic Lacewing at night in the Hallow.
blurb: An optional prismatic Hallow fairy whose dazzling rainbow attack patterns reward precise dodging with elite gear.

name: Ravager
summon: Use a Death Whistle item.
blurb: A grotesque grounded flesh construct that hops and hurls its own dismembered limbs across the surface battlefield.

name: Lunatic Cultist
summon: Kill the cultists at the Dungeon entrance after Golem.
blurb: The vanilla robed cultist whose defeat triggers the Lunar Events and the Celestial Pillars.

name: Astrum Deus
summon: Use a Titan Heart or Starcore at the Astral Beacon at night.
blurb: A celestial burrowing worm with shifting blue-and-orange astral phases, the intended final pre-Moon Lord Calamity boss.

name: Moon Lord
summon: Defeat all four Celestial Pillars, or use a Celestial Sigil.
blurb: The vanilla final boss and the climax of Hardmode, whose defeat opens the door to Calamity's post-Moon Lord content.

name: Profaned Guardians
summon: Use a Profaned Shard in the Underworld or the Hallow
blurb: A trio of holy fire guardians that gatekeep Providence, dropping the Profaned Core needed to summon her.

name: The Dragonfolly
summon: Use Exotic Pheromones in the Jungle
blurb: An optional cybernetic bird-of-prey, a faster and deadlier echo of the Bumblebirds, dropping Effulgent Feathers for progression gear.

name: Providence, the Profaned Goddess
summon: Use a Profaned Core in the Hallow or the Underworld
blurb: The radiant goddess of the Profaned flame, the first major Post-Moon Lord wall and the source of the Mark that unlocks the Sentinels.

name: Storm Weaver
summon: Use the Mark of Providence while in the sky
blurb: A colossal electric serpent and one of the three Sentinels of the Devourer, fought high in the sky.

name: Ceaseless Void
summon: Use the Mark of Providence while in the Dungeon
blurb: A tear in reality flanked by orbiting Dark Energies, a Sentinel of the Devourer fought within the Dungeon.

name: Signus, Envoy of the Devourer
summon: Use the Mark of Providence while in the Underworld
blurb: A shadowy assassin Sentinel of the Devourer that drops Twisting Nether used to craft the Cosmic Worm.

name: Polterghast
summon: Kill 30 Phantom Spirits or use the Necroplasmic Beacon in the Dungeon
blurb: A tormented mass of Dungeon souls that awakened from the necromantic energy, gating access to the deeper abyss.

name: The Old Duke
summon: Complete the Acid Rain event or fish with a Bloodworm in the Sulphurous Sea
blurb: An optional mutated Duke Fishron of the Sulphurous Sea, unleashed at the climax of the tier-3 Acid Rain event.

name: The Devourer of Gods
summon: Use a Cosmic Worm anywhere at any time
blurb: The god-eating cosmic serpent and Calamity's signature superboss, a brutal endgame gate that tears through dimensions.

name: Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
summon: Use a Blessed Phoenix Egg anywhere at any time
blurb: The immortal jungle dragon and Yharim's loyal guardian, a fiery two-phase gauntlet before the final trials.

name: Exo Mechs
summon: Press the Contact button on a fully completed Codebreaker
blurb: Draedon's ultimate war machines - Ares, Thanatos, and Artemis & Apollo - fought together as one of the two final bosses.

name: Supreme Witch, Calamitas
summon: Interact with an Altar of the Accursed using Ashes of Calamity or a Ceremonial Urn
blurb: The brimstone witch and Calamity's true final boss, an unrelenting bullet-hell duel that caps the mod's progression.
